betaNotes:
Expanded learning preview: 26 new reading lessons with 78 explained sections and worked code examples. The course now has 73 teaching lessons across 13 units, plus 22 prediction challenges.

Read without compiling: deeper slices and concurrent access, cancellation and bounded work, GC and memory budgets, goroutines and OS threads, profiling, native HTTP/Gin, Redis capacity and cache failures, architecture and clean code, Bash, Docker, Podman and Kubernetes. Commands and native service examples are for your own development environment; the iOS sandbox capabilities are unchanged.

Review now has an explicit Finish review action. Boards use at least three learned pairs and sessions at least three rounds; small learned pools are reinforced without introducing unfinished concepts. Restart resets completion controls.

iPhone landscape section controls remain fixed when the software keyboard opens; the keyboard may cover them. Please check reading completion survives reopening, code full screen, Review finish/restart, mistakes, and keyboard rotation. Established Duo laptop and portrait workspaces are unchanged.
